start: app.mettleup.fit welcome page on a phone, "Create my gym" form; checking by WhatsApp is on (the person sends a message)

steps.action: Type "Gym name", "Your name" and "Your mobile number"
user_sees: Hint "You sign in with this number. You check it by sending us one WhatsApp message. It is free."
must_not: More than 10 digits accepted

steps.action: Type "Choose a 6-digit PIN" and "Type the PIN again"
user_sees: Hint "You sign in with your mobile number and this PIN. Keep it private."
must_not: The PIN shown in clear

steps.action: Tick "I agree to the MettleUp terms and the data agreement." and tap the green "Verify with WhatsApp"
user_sees: WhatsApp opens with a message ready; back on the page "Send the message in WhatsApp" and "Waiting for your message"
must_not: A gym made before the number is checked
The tick set by itself

steps.action: Send the message, come back
user_sees: "Number checked" and "+91 <number> is yours."; the main button is now "Create my gym"
must_not: "Number checked" for a message sent from another number

steps.action: Tap "Create my gym"
user_sees: Button reads "Setting up…"
The new gym opens, with the gym code and join link shown once
must_not: Two gyms from a double tap
The gym made without the PIN or without the terms record
The address left on the sign-up link, so a refresh opens sign-up again

start: "Create my gym" form while the older WhatsApp code way is on (MettleUp sends a code)

steps.action: Fill the form, tick the terms, tap "Get code on WhatsApp"
user_sees: "We sent a 6-digit code to +91 <number> on WhatsApp. It works for 10 minutes."
Box "Code from WhatsApp" and "Send a new code"
must_not: A gym made before the code is typed

steps.action: Type the code, tap "Create my gym"
user_sees: The new gym opens
must_not: A wrong or old code accepted: "That code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new code."

start: "Create my gym" form while checking by WhatsApp is switched off

steps.action: Fill the form
user_sees: Hint "You sign in with this number on any phone or computer."; the main button is "Create my gym" from the start
must_not: A WhatsApp step shown

steps.action: Tick the terms, tap "Create my gym"
user_sees: The new gym opens
must_not: The gym made for a number nobody checked while the words say it was checked

steps.action: Tap the main button with a 1-letter gym name
user_sees: "Type your gym’s name."
must_not: Any call to the server

steps.action: Fix it, leave "Your name" empty
user_sees: "Type your name."
must_not: Any call to the server

steps.action: Fix it, type 9 digits as the mobile
user_sees: "Type a 10-digit mobile number, like 98290 12345."
must_not: Any call to the server

steps.action: Fix it, type PIN 123456, then two different PINs
user_sees: "Don’t use digits in order, like 123456 or 654321. Pick a PIN that is hard to guess."
"The two PINs are not the same. Type the same PIN in both boxes."
must_not: A weak PIN accepted

steps.action: Fix it, leave the terms box empty
user_sees: "Tick the box to agree to the terms. Then tap “Verify with WhatsApp”." (or "…Then tap “Create my gym” again." when no check is needed)
must_not: WhatsApp opened or a gym made without the tick

steps.action: Tap "Verify with WhatsApp" twice within a minute, or many times in an hour
user_sees: "You tapped "Verify with WhatsApp" a moment ago. Wait <n> seconds, then try again."
"Too many tries for this number. Wait an hour, then try again."
must_not: Unlimited new checks for one number

start: "Create my gym" form, number already checked ("Number checked" shows)

steps.action: Change one digit of the mobile number
user_sees: "Number checked" goes; the main button is "Verify with WhatsApp" again
must_not: The old check used for the new number

steps.action: Put the number back and wait more than 15 minutes, then tap "Create my gym"
user_sees: "This check has run out. Tap "Verify with WhatsApp" to check your number again."
must_not: A gym made with a used or old check
A dead end with no button to check again

steps.action: Tap "Create my gym" on slow internet with no answer
user_sees: "We could not hear back from MettleUp, so your gym may already be made. Tap “Sign in instead” and type your mobile number and the PIN you just chose. If that does not work, come back here and tap “Create my gym” again."
Button "Sign in instead"
must_not: A plain "try again" that makes a second gym

steps.action: Tap the "terms" and "data agreement" links, then create the gym
user_sees: Each opens in a new tab; the typed form is still there
Under the form: "Your members and payments are kept online. They stay safe if a phone or computer breaks."
must_not: The typed values lost by opening a link
The gym made without a record of who agreed, when and to which version
The mobile number or the PIN left in the address bar or in the browser's storage
The checked number kept after the check is used

start: Just after "Create my gym" succeeded; the person is now the gym's owner on this device

steps.action: Look at the first page
user_sees: The new gym by its typed name, with the gym code and join link shown once
Signed in as the owner, no second sign-in
must_not: Somebody else's gym
A demo gym or an older browser-only gym mixed into the new one: an old copy on this browser is set aside, not merged or deleted

steps.action: Open Staff & sign-in
user_sees: The "You" card with the typed name, "Owner" and "+91 <number>"; "You sign in with your mobile number and your own PIN (set on <today>)."
must_not: "You have no PIN yet" straight after choosing one
The terms card asked again right after ticking them at set-up

start: A person who already owns one gym opens the sign-up link (/start) on a signed-out device

steps.action: Fill "Create my gym" with the same mobile number and a new gym name, check the number, tap "Create my gym"
user_sees: Either a second gym is made and opened, or plain words say this number already has a gym and what to do
must_not: The first gym replaced, renamed or signed out without a word
A sign-in later that cannot tell which of the two gyms is meant

start: "Create my gym" tapped while many gyms start, or while MettleUp cannot be reached

steps.action: Tap "Create my gym"
user_sees: "Many gyms are starting right now. Please try again in a few minutes." or the "We could not hear back from MettleUp…" words with "Sign in instead"
must_not: A half-made gym: a gym with no owner, or an owner with no PIN and no way back in

steps.action: Tap "Sign in instead" and sign in with the number and the PIN just chosen
user_sees: The gym opens if it was made
must_not: Two gyms on one number after trying again

start: New owner signed in on the device that made the gym

steps.action: Refresh the page; open the bookmark of the sign-up link
user_sees: The gym, not the sign-up form
must_not: The sign-up form shown to a signed-in owner
The "gym code and join link" card shown again on every open

steps.action: Sign out, then sign in with mobile number and the PIN chosen at set-up
user_sees: The same gym
must_not: "That PIN or code is wrong" for the PIN chosen a minute ago

steps.action: Open Settings and read the terms line
user_sees: "You accepted the terms on <day> (version <version>)."
must_not: No line although the box was ticked at set-up
Another person named as the one who agreed
